page.overview:
Who is Doderic Brandybuck?

Doderic Brandybuck was a hobbit of the Shire.

Doderic was born in TA 2989 (SR 1389) to Seredic Brandybuck and Hilda Bracegirdle. He had two siblings: Ilberic Brandybuck and Celandine Brandybuck.

In , Doderic Brandybuck had ventured into the Old Forest along with his friend Rollo, son of Farmer Maggot. Saradoc Brandybuck asks the player to find them and send them back.
